text:
incident-bot: ALERT: streaming-tail p99 breach detected in us-west-2 cluster (3.2x baseline) — auto-mitigation applied: route-lowcost -> fallback-v2. Investigating root cause: sudden prefix-cache miss ratio spike on prefixes starting with 'kvu_'.
oncall-alex: seeing elevated paging and KV eviction logs. p95 also creeping up. Any recent prefix-hash deploys?
jules: we rolled the prefix-hash optimizer at 1747000000, but that was canaryed. Will check rollout status.
ben_sre: I see a surge of cache misses in the metrics: prefix_hit_rate dropped from 0.92 -> 0.45 around 1747036000. Paging IO ops doubled.
carmi: logs show many TTL-evict entries and a new prefix-salt header in requests. Could be salt mismatch causing miss amplification.
ben_sre: stack traces point to cache key normalization change in rc-prefixhash v3.4.3. I can pull the deploy timeline.
jen (ops-runner): customer paging reports from telemetry: large customers on dedicated pools see p99 > 1.2s for streaming chunk. Flagging potential customer impact.
oncall-alex: @jules can you confirm whether the prefixhash change toggled a hashing seed? If yes we need to roll back.
jules: confirmed, the canary toggled 'enable_salted_keys=true' for 10% and a late rollout pushed to 100% at 1747028000 due to a gradual rollout script bug.
tara: ok plan: 1) rollback prefixhash flag to false 2) force KV warmup for hot prefixes 3) route high-priority customers to legacy pool 4) monitor p99/p95 for 30m.
ben_sre: rollback initiated (deploy-bot): ``deploy-bot: started rollback rc-prefixhash v3.4.3 -> v3.4.2 [initiated by ben_sre]``
deploy-bot: UPDATE: rollback complete on us-west-2 at 1747039200.
carmi: after rollback we see hit_rate climbing slowly: 0.45 -> 0.7 within 8 minutes. Paging ops down ~40%.
oncall-alex: starting manual cache-warm for top-100 hot prefixes: ``for p in $(cat hot_prefixes.txt); do curl -s "https://cache-internal/warm?p=$p"; done`` — this should reduce cold miss storm.
jen (ops-runner): routing change: pinned critical accounts back to dedicated-legacy via traffic-shift (50% -> 100% over 10m). Confirming no 502s.
ben_sre: metrics note: streaming tail stalls dropped but p99 still elevated for some sessions (1.3x baseline). Suspect inflight KV evictions causing tail miss for long streaming sessions.
jules: can we enable prefix prefetch for sessions > 30s as a short-term mitigation? Toggle pushed to 10% — enabling now.
oncall-alex: customer-impact assessment: two enterprise customers reported degraded UX; severity: sev3. No customer escalations yet but ops-runner opened a support case to notify them.
carmi: digging into logs: some requests carried an old salt header from edge proxies which mismatched new hashing logic — likely mixed fleet during rollout.
ben_sre: long-term: add stricter rollout checks for keying changes and a canary gating that verifies hit_rate delta < 5% over 30m before rollout continues.
oncall-alex: current status: rollback complete, warmup active, traffic pinned, prefetch enabled for long sessions. p95 back to near baseline, p99 at 1.1x.
jen (ops-runner): starting 1hr watch. On-call handoff at 1747041600 to @tara.
oncall-alex: handing off to @tara — wrote summary and actions above. I'll stay reachable for questions.
tara: taking over. I'll coordinate with SREs to validate warmup and escalate to eng-runtime if p99 doesn't drop <= 1.05x in 30m.
incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: severity downgraded to monitoring at 1747041200. Close after stable 1h.
ops-runner: support case #INC-7832 created and customers notified with mitigation summary.
jules: postmortem owners: jules (root cause), ben_sre (mitigation timeline), carmi (observability gaps). Will draft postmortem and include checklist for keying-rollouts.
tara: thanks all — keeping this thread open while I monitor. :white_check_mark:
